title: Police seize P5.9M in contraband cigarettes off Zamboanga coast
summary: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police operatives recovered a haul of abandoned contraband cigarettes with an estimated customs value of P5,932,449.60 along the coastal waters of Sta. Cruz Island…
